title: Treating Depression on a Day-to-day Basis: Development of a Tool for Physicians Based on a Smartphone Application
official: Treating Depression on a Day-to-day Basis: Development of a Novel Clinical Tool for Physicians Based on a Smartphone Application, the SMART Project (Smartphones and Mood Disorders, an Application for Research and Treatment)
summary: Testing and validating an e-health (smartphone application) approach to better understand the determinants of day-to-day symptomatology in depression, medication adherence, and treatment efficacy in the goal of maximizing patient care.
